name: Vision of Dahak AP OLD
description: Blasts of fire and smoke pour out of the tunnel walls to coalesce into the burning form of Dahak himself; a PC who succeeds at a DC 20 Religion check to Recall Knowledge notes that the fiery dragon closely resembles classical depictions of the draconic god of destruction.
disable: DC 26 Religion (expert) to utter prayers to a non-evil deity to counteract Dahak's presence (prayers to Apsu allow this check to be made if the character is merely trained in Religion), DC 30 Thievery (expert) to divert the hazard's energies back upon themselves, or a successful Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26).
reset: The vision of Dahak deactivates and resets automatically once no creatures remain within the Huntergate way station.
routine: (2 actions) The vision of Dahak manifests next to the creature that is closest to the center of the way station, then uses its Breath Weapon in a direction that catches the most possible targets in its area.

generalAbilities.name: Manifest
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature is within the way station.

Effect The vision of Dahak appears in a 15-foot space adjacent to that creature and rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
generalAbilities.description: The vision of Dahak unleashes a blast of fire from its burning maw, creating a 60ft Cone that deals 6d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures within (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save).
